messages:
leah-billing: Heads-up: Aurora Clinics (acct: AC-9911) failed ACH onboarding. Bank returned 'account_type_mismatch' during microdeposit — invoice 50901 ($45,600) is due next week. Customer asks if we can accept a one-time wire to avoid suspension.
michael-payments: Paste the gateway error please. Could be corporate checking not supporting microdeposits.
leah-billing: Webhook: `status: failed`, `decline_code: account_type_mismatch`, `bank_message: Microdeposit not supported for account`. Customer note: 'treasury used corporate checking; bank says no retail microdeposits'.
ops-oncall: If it's corporate acct, Plaid instant-link may also be rejected. Ops: please pause autopay retries until this is resolved to avoid duplicate captures.
nora-finance: Two checks: 1) Any prior chargebacks/disputes? 2) Is autopay currently enabled? If no disputes and autopay failing, manual wire ok but we need VP sign-off since amount close to threshold.
leah-billing: Autopay enabled and currently failing. No disputes. Customer can wire today if we provide details and confirm remittance email.
billing-bot: Payment attempt recorded 2026-12-12 16:41 UTC (txn: pay_b9f7). Retry policy has next attempt scheduled.
michael-payments: I'm okay approving wires under $50k. @cecilia-vpfinance can you confirm? Also request a signed billing addendum for the one-off settlement for audit trail.
cecilia-vpfinance: Approve one-time wire acceptance for invoice 50901 ($45,600). Conditions: (1) remittance email to billing@redwood.ai with bank trace/reference; (2) upload wire confirmation to billing folder; (3) attach signed addendum. No contract changes.
leah-billing: Sending wire instructions and pro-forma to the customer's treasury now. Will CC support and finance. Please pause retries for AC-9911.
leah-billing: Wire instructions (sent):\n```\nBeneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.\nBank: National Commercial Bank\nRouting (ABA): 061000104\nAccount: 5544332211\nSWIFT: NCBKUS44\nReference: Invoice 50901 - AC-9911\nRemittance: billing@redwood.ai\nNote: Please include the invoice number in the bank reference and email a PDF of the bank confirmation.\n```
Customer replied: "Treasury to initiate wire today; will send trace by EOD in their timezone."
ops-oncall: Confirmed: support will pause autopay retries and add note to ticket to avoid double-charge.
michael-payments: After bank posts, we'll mark invoice paid and cancel the scheduled retries. Leah: upload the signed addendum and remittance email to the audit folder.
leah-billing: Will do. Checklist: signed addendum (pending), remittance email (pending), ledger reconciliation after bank posts.
billing-bot: Flag created: MANUAL_WIRE-3341. Audit log entry required.
nora-finance: Thanks — once funds post I'll reconcile and close the invoice. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
